KURIAN, J.
1.
Leave granted.
2.
Mr. Mishra Sourabh, learned counsel appears for the
State of Madhya Pradesh and accepts notice.
3.
This  is  a  case  where  the  appellant  was  not
regularized as a Forest Guard on the ground that he had
contracted marriage before attaining the age of 21 years.
Apparently, there is only a difference of a few days.
4.
One of the grounds taken by the appellant in this
case is that several others have been granted relaxation.
5.
Four such instances have been pointed out before this
Court, they are Narayan Prasad Raikwar, Babulal Carpenter,
Raj Kishore Tiwari and Bhagatram Raikwar.
6.
If that be so, there is no point in keeping this
Appeal pending before this Court and we dispose of this
Appeal  with  a  direction  to  the  authority  concerned  to
consider the case of the appellant also in the same way as

7.

8.
